Post the period of the first four months , any delays or defaults by the Shipper , the Settlement 
Committee shall initiate discussions in good faith in order to arrive at an amicable solution for cases 
of non - payment by the Surplus Entity due to non - payment of dues under the GTAs by the Shipper ( s ) 
or delay in payment by the Shipper ( s ) where neither payment security mechanism can be invoked nor 
can the gas transmission be stopped . 


g ) In case of non - receipt of payment from the Shipper due to any stay order from any court and / or 
exhaustion of all the payment security instruments under the contract with such Shipper , then to that 
extent the Surplus Entit ( ies ) shall not be required to make payment to the Deficit Entit ( ies ) . The 
Deficit Entit ( ies ) shall receive such payment from Surplus Amount . In case there is no balance in the 
Surplus Amount , then the shortfall amount shall be shared by all the pipeline entities forming part of 
the NGGS , in proportion to the revenue entitlement by making necessary adjustment in the following 
fortnight settlement working and the same shall be made good after the amount has been received 
from such customer , or in the following fortnight , or through adjustment in next UFT review , 
whichever is earlier . Further , for such a specific customer , the revenues and volumes from that 
customer shall not be considered for revenue entitlement from the following fortnight settlement 
workings and UFT determination at the time of next UFT review . Any amount received from such 
customer after the stay is vacated the same shall be considered as a part of the settlement mechanism . 


h ) Based on the settlement data of first month , the Settlement Committee shall identify the surplus and 
deficit entity ( ies ) for the following quarter . The surplus entity ( ies ) shall furnish the payment security 
to the deficit entity ( ies ) . In this regard Settlement committee shall formulate a payment security 
mechanism during the first month . Further , Settlement Committee shall also review the data sharing , 
payment timelines and payment security mechanism once the software is developed / IT system is in 
place . 


2.9 . Dispute Resolution Mechanism : 

a ) Initially the dispute shall be attempted to be resolved mutually among the entities involved in the 
dispute . In case of failure to resolve , the Settlement Committee shall be approached by the affected 
entity ( s ) for resolution of the dispute . 


b ) The dispute / issue shall be discussed in a joint meeting held between Settlement Committee and the 
concerned entities for timely resolution . 


c ) In the event parties fail to resolve their settlement dispute through above mechanism , such disputes 
may be referred to the Board for final decision . 

2.10 . Surplus Amount Management 

a ) In case of surplus revenue collection within a fortnight , post payment to Deficit Entities , such Surplus 
Amount shall be identified by the Settlement Committee and the same shall be acknowledged by the 
relevant entity . 


b ) This Surplus Amount at the end of the month shall be invested in a callable fixed deposit ( FD ) by the 
respective entities with at - least having a long term credit rating of AA + from at least two credit rating 
agencies registered with SEBI , provided that the surplus amount with the entity is minimum Rupees 
Ten Lakh . 


c ) The FD amount along with the interest accrued after deduction of applicable tax on the interest 
income and any other expenses , as agreed by Settlement Committee , incurred for management over 
the year shall be used for settlements throughout the year or for subsequent UFT adjustments . 

d ) The process of withdrawal mechanism from the Surplus Amount shall be as follows :

The Settlement Committee shall internally calculate and discuss the deductions applicable , 
and the available Surplus Amount accrued in each of the committee meetings . 


From time to time , the Settlement Committee shall deliberate on the usage of Surplus 
Amount either for settlement or as carryforward for subsequent UFT adjustments . 


e ) Based on the first four months of experience , the Settlement Committee shall decide the threshold 
funds with the approval of the Board to be maintained for the unforeseen circumstances of shortfall in 
the UFT collection . 


f ) In case of Deficit Amount , the Settlement Committee shall discuss the mechanism to make good such 
Deficit Amount till such Deficit Amount is made good on . The Industry Committee shall share the 
deficit amount in proportion to their revenue entitlement . 

2.11 . Imbalance Charges 

a ) Imbalance quantity shall be worked out by the entities as per the relevant regulation for their 
respective networks as per their contracts with the Shippers . 


2.12 . Miscellaneous 


The imbalance charges shall be at the applicable invoicing ratio of UFT for each of the individual 
entities in the contractual path . 


a ) 

In case of revised invoices to Shippers , the same shall be settled in the next billing / payment cycle . 


b ) Bad debts shall be dealt in respective Gas Transmission Agreements ( GTAs ) and the same shall not 
impact settlement amount and payment timelines except as provided in paragraph 3.7 above .

( Legislative Department ) 


New Delhi , the 29th March , 2023 / Chaitra 8 , 1945 ( Saka ) 

The following Act of Parliament received the assent of the President on the 
29th March , 2023 and is hereby published for general information : — 

THE APPROPRIATION ( NO . 2 ) ACT , 2023 
No. 5 OF 2023 


[ 29th March 2023. ] 

An Act to authorise payment and appropriation of certain further sums from and 
out of the Consolidated Fund of India for the services of the financial year 
2022-23 . 


BE it enacted by Parliament in the Seventy - fourth Year of the Republic of India as 
follows : 


1. This Act may be called the Appropriation ( No. 2 ) Act , 2023 . 

2. From and out of the Consolidated Fund of India there may be paid and applied 
sums not exceeding those specified in column 3 of the Schedule amounting in the aggregate 
to the sum of two lakh seventy thousand five hundred eight crore and eighty - nine lakh 
rupees towards defraying the several charges which will come in course of payment during 
the financial year 2022-23 in respect of the services specified in column 2 of the Schedule . 


3. The sums authorised to be paid and applied from and out of the Consolidated Fund 
of India by this Act shall be appropriated for the services and purposes expressed in the 
Schedule in relation to the said year .

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 29th March, 2023 


G.S.R. 230(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution, the 


President hereby makes the following rules to amend the Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue, Directorate of 
Enforcement, Assistant Director of Enforcement, Group ‘A’ post, Recruitment Rules, 2020, namely: - 


l. 


Short title and commencement. - (l) These rules may be called the Ministry of Finance, Department of 
Revenue, Directorate of Enforcement, Assistant Director of Enforcement, Group ‘A’ post, Recruitment 
(Amendment) Rules, 2023. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


In the Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue, Directorate of Enforcement, Assistant Director of 
Enforcement, Group ‘A’ post, Recruitment Rules, 2020, in the Schedule, in Column (3), after the entries, the 
following Note shall be inserted, namely:- 


“Note:- Consultation with the Union Public Service Commission not necessary while appointing an officer on 
deputation basis for a period of one year with effect from 3'" February, 2023.” 


[K-022/74/202]-Ad.ED | 
SANDEEP GAHLOT, Under Secy. 


Note : The principal rules were published in the Gazette of India under Part I, Section 3, Sub-Section (i) vide number

का.आ. 1511 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1683 ( अ ) , जो भारत के राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , 
खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में दिनांक 07.04.2022 को प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा पंजाब राज्य के गुरदासपुर जिले में NH503D 
के कि.मी. 22 से कि . मी . 69 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , 
प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की 
घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 12.04.2022 " 
को " हिंदुस्तान टाइम्स " और " अजीत " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ( जिला राजस्व अधिकारी गुरदासपुर ) ने उन पर विचार कर लिया 
है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया है ; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


( 1 ) 


[ PART II— SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


2 


और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 29th March , 2023 

S.O. 1511 ( E ) . – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , S.O. 1683 , dated 07/04/2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub 
section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation 
of NH503D on the stretch of land from Km . 22 to Km . 69 in the district of GURDASPUR in the state of PUNJAB ; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Hindustan times " and " Ajit " both 
dated 12/04/2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ( District Revenue Officer Gurdaspur ) ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय 

अधिसूचना 

नई दिल्ली , 28 मार्च , 2023 


का.आ. 1461 ( अ ) .– केन्द्रीय सरकार , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात् कि महाराष्ट्र राज्य के भंडारा जिले में NH53 के कि.मी. 485 से कि.मी. 508.1 ( सुब डिविशनल अफसर , 
भंडारा ) तक के भू - खण्ड के निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2 लेन / 4 लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और 
प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , ऐसी भूमि का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् स ड ऊ , भंडारा को लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें 
उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी विधिक पेशेवर 
द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात् , यदि कोई 
हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा । 


( 1 )

उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 2 ) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा । 


2 


इस अधिसूचना के अंतर्गत आने वाली भूमि के रेखांक और अन्य ब्यौरे सक्षम प्राधिकारी के उक्त कार्यालय में 
उपलब्ध हैं और उनका हितबद्ध व्यक्तियों द्वारा निरीक्षण किया जा सकता है ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 28th March , 2023 

S.O. 1461 ( E ) . In exercise of powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government , after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose , the land , the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below , is required for building 
( widening / two lane with paved shoulder / four laning etc. , ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH53 in the 
stretch of land from Km 485 to Km508.1 ( Sub Divisional Officer , Bhandara ) in the district of BHANDARA in the 
state of MAHARASHTRA , hereby declares its intention to acquire such land . 


Any person interested in the said land may , within twenty - one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3C of the said Act . 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority , namely , S D O , Bhandara in writing and 
shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard , 
either in person or by a legal practitioner , and may , after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry , if any , as the Competent Authority thinks necessary , by order , either allow or disallow the objections .

का.आ. 1450 ( अ ) . केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का . आ . 4393 ( अ ) दिनाँक 20 सितम्बर 2022 , जो भारत के 
राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा तेलंगाना राज्य के मेडक जिले में मेडक 
येल्लारेड्डी - रुद्रर सेक्शन के NH - 765D के कि . मी . 78.700 से कि.मी. 176.800 ( आरडीओ - मेडक ) तक के भूखण्ड पर टोल 
प्लाजा के निर्माण , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन 
करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 20.10.2022 " 
को " नमस्ते तेलंगाना " ( तेलुगु ) और " द हिन्दू " ( अंग्रेजी ) दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी को किसी भी व्यक्ति से कोई आक्षेप प्राप्त नहीं हुए थे ; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा उघ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 28th March , 2023 

S.O. 1450 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , S.O.4393 ( E ) dated on 20th September 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , 
Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance , management and operation 
of Medak - Yellareddy - Rudrur section of NH - 765D on the stretch of land from Km . 78.700 to Km . 176.800 ( RDO 
office , Main road , Medak town , Medak District ) in the district of MEDAK in the state of TELANGANA . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Namasthe Telangana " ( Telugu ) 
and “ The Hindu ” ( English ) both dated 20.10.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 

And whereas no objections has been received from any person by the Competent Authority ; 

And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा दिल्ली राज्य के दक्षिण पश्चिम दिल्ली

राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से 
उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " १ ९ फरवरी 
२०२३ " को " द इंडियन एक्सप्रेस " और " दैनिक भास्कर " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया

रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 28th March , 2023 

S.O. 1443 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , S.O. 677 ( E ) dated 14th February 2023 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , 
Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and 
operation of NH - 344 M on the stretch of land from Km . 26 to Km . 39 ( old Terminal Tax Building Kapashera , New 
Delhi ) in the district of SOUTH WEST DELHI in the state of DELHI . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " The Indian express " and " Dainik 
Bhaskar ” both dated 19th February 2023 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred by 
the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land specified in the 
said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares 
that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 28th March , 2023 

S.O. 1453 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O. 2950 ( E ) dated on 30 June 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , 
Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction of ( widening / two lane with paved shoulder / four 
laning etc. , ) Toll Plaza Maintenance , management and operation of Jangaon - Duddeda Road Section of 
NH - 365B on the stretch of land from Km . 86.160 to Km . 131.370 ( old chainage Km . 0.000 to Km . 46.400 ) 
( Revenue Division Office , Janagaon ) in the district of Jangaon in the state of Telangana . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Namasthe Telangana ” ( Telugu ) 
and " The Hindu ” ( English ) both dated 21.07.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas ( 12 ) objection petitions have been received from the intrested persons / land loosers under 
Sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3C of NH Act towards the change of alignment . 


Accordingly , the CALA Jangaon has disposed the obejections under Sub - section ( 2 ) of Section 3C of NH Act 
vide this office procgs No. A / 1498 / 2022 dated 14.11.202 . 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

New Delhi , the 28th March , 2023 

S.O. 1454 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways ,, published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub 
section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH - 352W on the 
stretch of land from Km . 0 to Km . 45 ( Mini Secretariat Gurugram ) in the district of Gurugram in the state of 

HARYANA ; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Aaj Samaj " and " Top Story " both 
dated 13/12/2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

का.आ. 1456 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 की उप - धारा ( 1 ) दद्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात् कि उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के श्रावस्ती जिले में NH - 730 के कि.मी. 281.930 से कि.मी. 284.900 के मध्य 
गिलौला बाईपास के भू - खण्ड के निर्माण ( चौडीकरण / पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2 लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और 
प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , ऐसी भूमि का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा उग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपति प्रकट कर सकेगा ।

ऐसी प्रत्येक आपति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् विशेष भूमि अध्याप्ति अधिकारी श्रावस्ती / बहराइच को लिखित रूप 
प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपतिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप 
में या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपतियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच 
करने के पश्चात् , यदि कोई हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपतियों को अनुज्ञात कर 
सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा

हितबद्ध पक्षकारों को ऐसे अनुरोध का निरीक्षण करने की अनुमति देने की स्वतंत्रता होगी । 


गोपनीय अंश में ऐसी समस्त सूचना शामिल होगी , जो स्वभाव से गोपनीय है और / या अन्य सूचना जिसके सूचना 
प्रदाता ने उसके गोपनीय होने का दावा किया है । स्वभाव से गोपनीय होने का दावा की गई सूचना या अन्य 
कारणों की वजह से गोपनीय होने का दावा की गई सूचना के संबंध में ऐसी सूचना के प्रदाता के लिए प्रदत्त सूचना 
के साथ इस बात का पर्याप्त और पूर्ण कारण संबंधी विवरण प्रस्तुत करना अपेक्षित है कि ऐसी सूचना का प्रकटन 
क्यों नहीं किया जा सकता है । 


हितबद्ध पक्षकारों द्वारा प्रस्तुत सूचना का अगोपनीय रूपांतरण अनिवार्य रूप से उस सूचना , जिसके बारे में 
गोपनीयता का दावा किया गया है , पर निर्भर रहते हुए अधिमानतः सूचीबद्ध या रिक्त छोड़ी गई ( यदि सूचीबद्ध 
करना व्यवहार्य न हो ) और सारांशीकृत गोपनीय सूचना के साथ गोपनीय रूपांतरण की अनुकृति होना अपेक्षित है ।

F. No. 6 / 17 / 2022 - DGTR . — Having regard to the Customs Tariff Act , 1975 as amended in 1995 ( hereinafter 
referred to as the Act ) and the Customs Tariff ( Identification , Assessment and Collection of Duty or Additional 
Duty on Dumped Articles and for Determination of Injury ) Rules , 1995 ( hereinafter referred to as AD Rules ) . 


M / s Manali Petrochemicals Ltd. , has filed an application before the Designated Authority ( hereinafter referred 
to as the Authority ) in accordance with the Customs Tariff Act , 1975 as amended from time to time ( hereinafter 
referred to as the Act ) and Customs Tariff ( Identification , Assessment and Collection of Anti - Dumping Duty on 
Dumped articles and for Determination of injury ) Rules , 1995 as amended from time to time ( hereinafter 
referred to as the “ AD Rules ” ) for the initiation of an anti - dumping investigation concerning imports of Flexible 
Slabstock Polyol ( hereinafter also referred to as the " subject goods " ) originating in or exported from China PR 
and Thailand ( hereinafter referred to as the " subject countries " ) . 

A. Product under consideration ( PUC ) 

The product under consideration in the present investigation is Flexible Slabstock Polyol ( hereinafter also 
referred to as " FSP " ) . It is a clear viscous liquid polymer of molecular weight 3000-4000 , manufactured by 
polymerization of propylene oxide and ethylene oxide with a triol chain starter . It is a polyether and on reaction 
with catalysts and additives yields polyurethane foams that are used in upholstery , mattresses , pillows , bolsters , 
transport seating and packaging . It is transported in tankers or stored in steel drums . 


The PUC does not have a dedicated classification code under the Customs Tariff Act , 1975. It is imported under 
Chapter I leading 39 " Plastics and Articles and its classification at the 4 - digit level is 3907. At the six - digit 
level , the subject goods are being classified and imported under various sub - headings like 3907 20 , 3907 29 , 
3907 99 of Schedule - I of the Customs Tariff Act , 1975. The customs classification code is indicative only and is 
not binding on the scope of the PUC as the imports of the PUC may be reported under various other 
subheadings . 


All interested parties to the investigation may provide their proposal for construction of PCNs , if any , within 20 
days from the issue of this notification 

B. Like Article 

The applicant has claimed that the subject goods , which are being dumped into India , are identical to the goods 
produced by the domestic industry . There are no known differences between the subject goods exported from 
China PR and Thailand and the goods produced by the applicant . The goods produced by the domestic industry 
and originating in or exported from China PR and Thailand into the domestic market of India are comparable in 
terms of essential product characteristics such as physical and chemical characteristics , manufacturing process 
and technology , functions and uses , product specifications , pricing , distribution and marketing and tariff 
classification of the goods . The consumers have used and are using the two products interchangeably . For the 
purpose of the present investigation , the goods produced by the domestic industry are being treated as ' like 
article ' to the subject goods imported from the subject countries . 

C. Domestic Industry and Standing 


The application has been filed by M / s . Manali Petrochemicals Ltd on behalf of the domestic industry . The 
applicant has claimed that it is the sole domestic producer of the like article in India and therefore , accounts for 
100 % share of the total domestic production . The applicant has submitted that they do not have any related 
party in China PR and Thailand nor have they imported the subject goods during the POI from the subject 
countries . Accordingly , as per the available information , it is held that the applicant constitutes domestic 
industry within the meaning of the Rule 2 ( b ) of the AD Rules and the application satisfies the criteria of 
standing in terms of Rule 5 ( 3 ) of the AD Rules . 

D. Subject countries 


8. The application has been filed in respect of the alleged dumping of the product under consideration from China 
PR and Thailand ( hereinafter referred to as the subject countries ' ) .

E. Period of Investigation 

The period of investigation ( POI ) for the purpose of present investigation is 1st January 2022 to 31st December , 
2022 ( 12 months ) . For the purpose of analyzing injury , the periods 2019-20 , 2020-21 , 2021-22 and the period 
of investigation ( POI ) have been considered . 

F. Basis of Alleged Dumping 


i . Normal Value for China PR 

The applicant has claimed that in terms of Article 15 ( a ) ( i ) of China's Accession Protocol and para 7 of the 
Annexure I to the AD Rules , the normal value of producers from China PR may be determined based on the 
cost or domestic selling price prevailing in China PR only if the responding producers from the subject country 
demonstrate that their cost and price information are based on market driven principles and allow for fair 
comparison in terms of paras 1 to 6 of Annexure I to the AD Rules , failing which , normal value for the 
producers from the subject country must be determined in accordance with paras 7 and 8 of Annexure I to the 
AD Rules . 


The applicant has submitted that the data relating to cost or price in a market economy third country or recourse 
other alternative methods is not available at this stage . The applicant has submitted that it has not been able to 
ascertain any surrogate country for China PR at this stage . Further , the import volume of the subject goods from 
a non - dumping third country / country to India is negligible . The normal value has been , therefore , constructed 
based on the best estimates of the cost of production of the subject goods as per the best information available 
after duly adjusting the selling , general and administrative expenses with reasonable profit margin . The normal 
value has been computed based on the cost of production of the domestic industry after duly the selling , 
general and administrative expenses with reasonable profit margin . 

ii . Normal Value for Thailand 


With respect to Thailand , the applicant has submitted that it had made efforts to acquire information regarding 
prices of the subject goods in the domestic market of Thailand . The applicant also attempted to obtain price list 
of the exporters or price evidence for the export to other countries from Thailand but was not able to find any 
accurate and reliable information as there in no dedicated HS code for the subject goods . Further , the the import 
volume of the subject goods from a non - dumping third country / country to India is negligible . The normal value 
has been , therefore , constructed based on the best estimates of the cost of production of the subject goods as per 
the best information available after duly adjusting the selling , general and administrative expenses with 
reasonable profit margin . The normal value has been computed based on the cost of production of the domestic 
industry after duly the selling , general and administrative expenses with reasonable profit margin . 

iii . Export Price 


The applicant has claimed export price of the subject goods by considering the CIF reported in the secondary 
source data . The price adjustments have been made on account of ocean freight , marine insurance , inland 
transportation , port handling and clearance charges , commission , credit cost and bank charges . In case of 
exports from China PR VAT has also been adjusted . 

G. Dumping Margin 

The normal value and the export price , have been compared at ex - factory level which prima facie establishes a 
dumping margin above the de - minimis level in respect of the subject goods from the subject countries . Thus , 
there is sufficient prima facie evidence , that the subject goods are being dumped into the domestic market of 
India by the producers / exporters from the subject countries . 

H. Injury and Causal Link 


15. Information furnished by the applicant has been considered for assessment of injury to the domestic industry . 
The applicant has furnished evidence regarding the injury having taken place as a result of the alleged dumping 
in the form of increased volume of dumped imports in absolute terms and in relation to production and 
consumption in India , price undercutting , price suppression , decline in market share of the domestic industry , 
profitability , cash profits and return on capital employed . The Authority , based on the information submitted by 
the applicant , is of the view that there is sufficient prima facie evidence of the injury being suffered by the 
domestic industry caused by dumped imports from the subject countries to justify initiation of an anti - dumping 
investigation .

New Delhi, the 28th March, 2023 


S.O. 444(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub- 
section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of |956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), vide 
5.00. No. 6l55(E) dated 29th December 2022, the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (six-laning), maintenance, management and 
operation of Newly Proposed Raipur Visakhapatnam NH-l30 CD Economic Corridor on the stretch of land from 
Km. 239.650 to Km. 366.500 (O/o- Tahasildar, Semiliguda Dist-Koraput) in the district of KORAPUT in the state of 
ODISHA; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in "Odisha Bhaskar" in l6th January 
2023 and "Sambad" dated |6th January 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi the 28th March, 2023 


S.O. 1445(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under 
sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), 
vide $.O. No. 6153(E) dated 29th December 2022, the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (six-laning), maintenance, management and 
operation of Newly Proposed Raipur Visakhapatnam NH-130 CD Economic Corridor on the stretch of land from 
Km. 239.650 to Km. 366.500 (O/o- Tahasildar, Pottangi Dist-Koraput) in the district of KORAPUT in the state of 
ODISHA.

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in "Pragativadi" in 16th January 2023 
and "The Prameya" dated 16th January 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा पंजाब राज्य के लुधियाना जिले में NH205K के 
कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी. 66.7 ( लुधियाना रूपनगर खंड ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का बनाने ,

रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

का.आ. 1447 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4196 ( अ ) तारीख 08/09/2022 , जो भारत के राजपत्र , 
असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा पंजाब राज्य के होशियारपुर जिले में NH503A 
( पैकेज IV ) होशियारपुर बाईपास सहित कि.मी 108.395 से कि.मी. 135.145 ( डिजाइन चेनेज कि.मी. 0 + 000 से 
किमी 15 + 800 ) ( जिला राजस्व अधिकारी होशियारपुर ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण ( चौड़ा करने / चार लेन का 
बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन 
करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी : 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 10/09/2022 " 
को " हिंदुस्तान टाइम्स " और " अजीत " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 28th March , 2023 

S.O. 1447 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , .S.O . 4196 ( E ) dated 08/09/2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , 
Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and 
operation of NH503 - A ( Package - IV ) including Hoshiarpur Bypass in the stretch of land from Km . 108.395 to Km . 
135.145 ( Design Chainage Km . 0.000 to Km . 15.800 ) ( District Revenue Officer Hoshiarpur ) in the district of 
HOSHIARPUR in the State of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Hindustan Times " and " Ajit " both 
dated 10/09/2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

का.आ. 1449(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1588 (अ), दिनांक 04 अप्रैल 2022 , जो भारत के 
राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) F प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा राजस्थान राज्य के डूंगरपुर जिले 
में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग संखया - 927A के कि.मी. 193+560 से कि.मी. 226+100 (स्वरूपगंज -खेरवाडा- बांसवाडा- 
राज,/ म.प्र. बॉर्डर) तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाना आदि),, अनुरक्षण, 
प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की 
घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख " 04 अप्रैल 
2022" को "दैनिक भास्कर" और "राजस्थान पत्रिका" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


है; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 28th March, 2023 

S.O. 1449(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. 1588 (E) Dated 04th April, 2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part IJ, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), 
maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No. 927A in the stretch of land from Km 193+560 to 
Km 226+100 (Swaroopganj- Kherwara- Banswara- Raj/M.P. Border) in the District of Dungarpur in the State of 
Rajasthan. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Bhaskar” and “Rajasthan 
Patrika” both dated 29th April, 2022 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का . आ . 1457 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात् कि गुजरात राज्य के कच्छ जिले में NH 754K के कि.मी. 170.400 से कि.मी. 251.00 ( प्रान्त औफस 
बचाउ ) तक के भू - खण्ड के निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2 - लेन / 4 लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और 
प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , ऐसी भूमि का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् डैप्यटी कलैक्टर् & ऍस्डीऍम् को लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत की जाएगी 
और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी विधिक 
पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात् , यदि 
कोई हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर 
सकेगा । 


उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 2 ) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा ।

का.आ. 1459 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात् कि मणिपुर राज्य के उखरुल जिले में NH202 के कि.मी. 53.100 से कि.मी. 73.136 ( डिप्टी कमिश्नर 
ऑफिस , उखरुल ) तक के भू - खण्ड के निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2 लेन / 4 - लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , 
प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , 
ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् डिप्टी कमिश्नर , उखरुल को लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और 
उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी विधिक 
पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात् , यदि 


( 1 ) 


[ PART II— SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

कोई हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर 
सकेगा । 


2 


उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 2 ) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा । 


इस अधिसूचना के अंतर्गत आने वाली भूमि के रेखांक और अन्य ब्यौरे सक्षम प्राधिकारी के उक्त कार्यालय में 
उपलब्ध हैं और उनका हितबद्ध व्यक्तियों द्वारा निरीक्षण किया जा सकता है ।

का.आ. 1460 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात् कि मणिपुर राज्य के उखरुल जिले में NH202 के कि.मी. 73.136 से कि.मी .99.01 ( डिप्टी कमिश्नर 
ऑफिस , उखरुल ) तक के भू - खण्ड के निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 2 लेन / 4 - लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , 
प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , 
ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् डिप्यूटी कमिश्नर , उखरुल को लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और 
उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी विधिक 
पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात् , यदि 


( 1 )

कोई हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर 
सकेगा । 


2 


उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 2 ) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा । 


इस अधिसूचना के अंतर्गत आने वाली भूमि के रेखांक और अन्य ब्यौरे सक्षम प्राधिकारी के उक्त कार्यालय में 
उपलब्ध हैं और उनका हितबद्ध व्यक्तियों द्वारा निरीक्षण किया जा सकता है ।

अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया 
गया है , ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती 

। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् जॉयंट कलैक्टर , पार्वतीपुरम मान्यम को लिखित रूप में प्रस्तुत की 
जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी 
विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के

का . आ . 1523 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइपलाइन ( भूमि में उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन ) 
अधिनियम , 1962 ( 1962 का 50 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 की उपधारा ( 1 ) के 
अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का . आ . 4923 ( अ ) तारीख 
18 अक्टूबर 2022 , जो भारत के असाधारण राजपत्र तारीख 18 अक्टूबर 2022 में प्रकाषित की गई थी , द्वारा उस अधिसूचना से 
संलग्न अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि में तमिलनाडु राज्य में नेचुरल गैस परिवहन के लिए ऑयल एण्ड नेचुरल गैस कॉरपोरेशन 
लिमिटेड द्वारा दक्षिण कावेरी परीसंपति संजाल पाइपलाइन बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन के अपने 
आषय की घोषणा की थी . 


और उक्त असाधारण राजपत्र अधिसूचना की प्रतियां जनता को तारीख 21.01.2023 तक उपलब्ध करा दी गई थी 
और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन केन्द्रीय सरकार को रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 
और केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , उक्त रिपोर्ट पर विचार करने के पष्चात , और यह समाधान हो जाने पर कि उक्त भूमि 
पाइपलाइन बिछाने के लिए अपेक्षित है , उसमें उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने का विनिश्चय किया है ; 


अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह 
घोषणा करती है कि इस अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि में पाइपलाइन बिछाने के लिए उपयोग के अधिकार 
का अर्जन किया जाए ; 


( 1 )

और केन्द्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उपधारा ( 4 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह निर्देष 
देती है कि उक्त भूमि में उपयोग का अधिकार इस घोषणा के प्रकाषन की तारीख से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित होने के बजाए , 
सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर ऑयल एण्ड नेचुरल गैस कॉरपोरेशन लिमिटेड में निहित होगा । 


पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइपलाइन अधिनियम , 1962 की धारा 10 के अधीन किसी भी क्षतिपूर्ति के लिए ऑयल एण्ड 
नेचुरल गैस कॉरपोरेशन लिमिटेड पूर्णतया उत्तरदायी होगी और धारा 13 के अधीन पाइपलाइन से सम्बन्धित किसी भी मामले 
पर केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी और किसी भी राज्य सरकार या कॉर्पोरेशन के विरूद्ध कोई वाद या कानूनी कार्यवाही नहीं 
हो सकेगी ।

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 28th March , 2023 

S.O. 1471 ( E ) . — In exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government , after being satisfied 
that for the public purpose , the land , the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below , is required for 
building ( widening / 2 laning with paved shoulder ) , maintenance , management and operation of National Highway NH 
543 in the stretch of land from Km 10 + 300 to 15 + 085 km . to ( Shahdol to Sagartola - Road ) ( Tehsil - Sohagpur ) 
( Shahdol - Bypass ) in the district of Shahdol in the state of MADHYA PRADESH , hereby declares its intention to 
acquire such land . 


6 


[ PART II SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

Any person interested in the said land may , within twenty - one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3C of the said Act . 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority , namely , the Sub Divisional Magistrate , 
Sohagpur , District Shahdol , in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give 
the objector an opportunity of being heard , either in person or by a legal practitioner , and may , after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry , if any , as the Competent Authority thinks necessary , by order , 
eitherallow or disallow the objections . 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 


final .

New Delhi , the 28th March , 2023 

S.O. 1526 ( E ) .– Whereas by a notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Petroleum and 
Natural Gas S.O. No. 5294 ( E ) dated the 13th November , 2022 , issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3 of the 
Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines ( Acquisition of Right of User in Land ) Act , 1962 ( 50 of 1962 ) , ( hereinafter referred 
to as the said Act ) , published in the Extra Ordinary Gazette of India dated the 15th November , 2022 , the Central 
Government declared its intention to acquire the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that 
notification for the purpose of laying pipeline for transportation of Natural Gas Product , of Southern Cauvery Asset 
Pipelines Network Should be laid by Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited . 

And whereas copies of the said Extra Ordinary Gazette notification were made available to the public up to 


And whereas the competent authority has under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act submitted report 
to the Central Government . 


And whereas the Central Government , after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said 
land is required for laying the pipeline , has decided to acquire right of user therein ; 


Now , therefore , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 6 of the said Act , the 
Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline ; 


And further , in exercise of the powers conferred by sub - section ( 4 ) of section 6 of the said Act , the Central 
Government hereby directs that the right of user in the said land for laying the pipeline shall , instead of vesting in the 
Central Government , vest on the date of publication of the declaration , in Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited . , 
free from all encumbrances . 


Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited . Shall be exclusively liable for any compensation in terms of 
Section 10 of the P & MP Act , 1962. According to Section 13 , no suit , or other legal proceeding would lie against the 
Central Government , Competent Authority or any State Government or Corporation for any matter relating to the 
pipeline .

New Delhi , the 29th March , 2023 

S.O. 1508 ( E ) .— In exercise of powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways

the public purpose , the land , the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below , is required for building 
( widening / two lane with paved shoulder / four laning etc. , ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH527C in 
the stretch of land from Km 30.85 to Km 63.442 ( Dumra , Sitamarhi ) in the district of SITAMARHI in the state of 
BIHAR , hereby declares its intention to acquire such land .

notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3C of the said Act . 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority , namely , CALA , Sitamarhi in writing and 
shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard , 
either in person or by a legal practitioner , and may , after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry , if any , as the Competent Authority thinks necessary , by order , either allow or disallow the objections . 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 


final .

inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority .

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 28th March, 2023 


S.O. 474(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Greenfield 
Expressway in the stretch of land from Km 0 to Km7.8 (Prant Office, Tharad) in the district of Banaskantha in the 
state of GUJARAT, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(]) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Magistrate, Tharad 
in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 479(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways

the stretch of land from Km 0 to Km4.84 (Ambala) in the district of AMBALA in the state of HARYANA, hereby 
declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(]) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, DRO in writing and shall set out the 
grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or 
by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the 
Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 1478 ( E ) .— In exercise of powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways

stretch of land from Km 43.446 to Km 93.226 ( Rampur - Kathgodam Section Package - 2 ) in the district of UDHAM 
SINGH NAGAR in the state of UTTARAKHAND , hereby declares its intention to acquire such land . 


Any person interested in the said land may , within twenty - one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3C of the said Act .

Nainital in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an

का.आ. 1493 ( अ ) . – जबकि भारत के राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खंड 3 , उप - खंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय में भारत सरकार की अधिसूचना द्वारा धारा 3 ए की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के तहत जारी किया 
गया । राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( बाद में उक्त अधिनियम के रूप में संदर्भित ) , एसओ 2923 ( ई ) 
दिनांक 26 जुलाई , 2021 , केंद्र सरकार ने संलग्न अनुसूची में निर्दिष्ट भूमि का अधिग्रहण करने के अपने इरादे की घोषणा 
की । एनएच ग्रीन फील्ड्स रोड के गठन के लिए अधिसूचना और यह आवश्यक है भवन ( चौड़ाई / पक्की कंधे / 4 लेन आदि के 
साथ ) , रखरखाव , प्रबंधन , भूमि के नए प्रस्तावित खंड के संचालन के लिए 0.000 से 14.650 और कि.मी. 18.000 से 
19.300 , उत्तर और दक्षिण औद्योगिक क्लस्टर को जोड़ने वाला 4 लेन ग्रीन फील्ड , कृष्णापटनम रोड के पास कंडालेर क्रीक 
से थम्मिनापत्तनम ( भाग- I ) से मुथुकुर के पास नारिकेलपल्ले तक और एसपीएसआर नेल्लोर जिले में NH - 67 ( भाग- II ) पर 
समर्पित पोर्ट रोड का विस्तार , आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य । 


और जब उक्त अधिसूचना का सार क्रमश : " द हंस ऑफ इंडिया " और " आंध्र ज्योति " दिनांक 21.01.2023 में 
प्रकाशित किया गया है उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 एकी उप - धारा ( 3 ) के तहत ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है

का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है ।

प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा ।

S.O. 1510 ( E ) .– In exercise of powers conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways

the public purpose , the land , the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below , is required for building

stretch of land from Km 49.176 to Km70 ( Collectrate Office , Raebareli ) in the district of RAEBARELI in the state of 
UTTAR PRADESH , hereby declares its intention to acquire such land . 


Any person interested in the said land may , within twenty - one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette , object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub - section ( 1 ) of 
section 3C of the said Act . 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority , namely , Special Land Acquisition Officer , 
Nodal Officer , Raebareli in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard , either in person or by a legal practitioner , and may , after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry , if any , as the Competent Authority thinks necessary , by order , either 
allow or disallow the objections .

अधिसूचना 


नई दिल्ली , 29 मार्च , 2023 

का.आ. 1492 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार ने , सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय में भारत सरकार की अधिसूचना 
द्वारा , धारा के उप - खंड ( 1 ) के तहत जारी भारत के राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II , खंड 3 , उप - खंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग अधिनियम , 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( इसके बाद उक्त अधिनियम के रूप में संदर्भित ) के 3 ए , केंद्र सरकार ने भवन 
( चौड़ीकरण / चार लेन ) के लिए उक्त अधिसूचना से जुड़ी अनुसूची में निर्दिष्ट भूमि का अधिग्रहण करने के अपने इरादे की 
घोषणा की , नव प्रस्तावित राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग ( एनएच -71 ) का रखरखाव , प्रबंधन और संचालन , किमी . 57 + 046 से किमी . 
91 + 910 ( नायदुपेटा से तुर्पू कानुपुर ) ) ( राजस्व मंडल कार्यालय , सुल्लुरपेटा ) आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के तिरुपति जिले में । 


और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ए की उप - धारा ( 3 ) के तहत ; ट्रम्पेट इंटरचेंज के लिए उक्त अधिसूचना को " द हंस 
इंडिया " और " प्रजाशक्ति " दोनों में दिनांक 20-08-2022 , प्रकाशित और डीकेटी लैंड " आंध्र ज्योति " और " द हंस इंडिया " 
दोनों में दिनांक 18-09-2022 प्रकाशित किया गया है ; 

और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


, 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


( 1 ) 


[ PART II— SEC . 3 ( ii ) ] 

अतः अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


2 


और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

जाने वाली भूमि का संक्षिप्त विवरणकिमी से 57 + 046 से किमी . 91 + 910 ( नायदुपेटा से तुर्पू कानूपुर ) ( राजस्व मंडल 
कार्यालय , सुल्लुरपेटा ) आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के तिरुपति जिले में ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 29th March , 2023 

S.O. 1492 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub 
section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the 
Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said 
notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of Newly Proposed 
National Highay ( NH - 71 ) in the stretch of land from Km . 57 + 046 to Km . 91 + 910 ( Naidupet to Turpu Kanupur ) ) 
( Revenue Divisional Office , Sullurpet ) in the district of Tirupati in the State of ANDHRA PRADESH . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification for TRUMPET INTERCHANGE has 
been Published in " THE HANS INDIA " and " PRAJASAKTI " both dated : 20-08-2022 , and DKT Land Published 
in " ANDHRA JYOTHI " and " THE HANS INDIA " both dated : 18-09-2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the 
said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .
